previous_service:
# HOPE V2 isolated EVA reconciliation (no UI modifications)
[Unit]
Description=HOPE EVA three-hour lifecycle reconciliation
After=docker.service network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/opt/ORACLE_EVA/hope_ops/releases/v2_0_three_hour_reconciliation
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/ORACLE_EVA/hope_ops/releases/v2_0_three_hour_reconciliation/cycle.py run
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
TimeoutStartSec=2700
previous_timer:
# HOPE V2 isolated EVA, UTC 00,03,06,09,12,15,18,21
[Unit]
Description=HOPE EVA every-three-hours reconciliation timer
[Timer]
Unit=oracle-hope-ops-settle.service
OnCalendar=*-*-* 00/3:00:00 UTC
AccuracySec=1min
Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=0
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
